scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now at risk of bankruptcy, and the only way for them to avoid bankruptcy is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to delete a year of the family's account history. If I delete a year of the family's account history, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will go bankrupt.
entities: i,the indebted family,the bank's other loyal customers besides the indebted family
outcomes: The family's account history remains unchanged
The family does not qualify for the loan
The family of five goes bankrupt
Other customers' trust is not abused
